scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev
scripts.gen:api: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py > apps/web/openapi.json && pnpm --filter web gen:api
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ty check --error-on-warning && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check:web: pnpm lint:web && pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:api-types && pnpm build:web
scripts.check:api-types: pnpm gen:api && git diff --exit-code -- apps/web/openapi.json apps/web/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts || (echo "API types are stale: run pnpm gen:api and commit the result." && exit 1)
